heading: Frequently Asked Questions
text2: Quick answers to the questions we hear most about this service.

items.question: Can you build niche dating apps?
items.answer: Yes. Niche communities often work better than general apps.

items.question: How do you handle user privacy?
items.answer: We follow data protection best practices and give users control of their information.

items.question: Can I monetize with subscriptions?
items.answer: Yes. Premium plans and in-app purchases are supported.

items.question: How long does dating app development take?
items.answer: A launch-ready first version takes 8 to 12 weeks, while a full platform with customer, provider and admin apps takes 4 to 8 months.

items.question: Do you offer support after launch?
items.answer: Yes. We provide maintenance, updates, monitoring and new feature development after launch.
